Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About the job 
 Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
 Your Role 
 As an French speaking SAP Application Support Consultant , you will combine your SAP functional expertise with hands-on application support to keep critical business processes running effectively. You will work closely with business key users and distributed technical teams, taking ownership of issues through diagnosis, resolution or effective escalation.
 Own L2 incidents and service requests, performing functional and technical analysis across SAP processes, data, integrations and interfaces.
 Resolve issues within your functional scope and escalate complex cases to L3 with clear diagnostics, business impact and supporting evidence.
 Support problem management, release testing and hypercare activities, helping improve application stability and business continuity.
 Collaborate directly with business key users and global L2/L3 teams, translating business issues into actionable functional and technical requirements.
 The underlying support model includes incident and request ownership, application monitoring, root-cause analysis, testing, knowledge management, and collaboration with L3 and product teams
 Your Profile 
You bring strong functional expertise in at least one SAP domain, such as FI/CO, MM/Ariba, SD/MDG, Logistics, Manufacturing or GTS, together with sufficient technical knowledge to troubleshoot end-to-end issues. The attached role specification confirms these and related SAP specialisms across the application landscape.
You are comfortable analysing interfaces, integrations and application incidents, determining what can be resolved at L2 and when specialist L3 support is required.
You have experience with incident management, service requests, problem management, testing and hypercare, ideally within an application support or AMS environment. These responsibilities align directly with the attached L2 role definition.
French and English are required to engage effectively with French-speaking business users and international delivery teams. The detailed specification sets French at C1/C2 and English at B2+ for the nearshore profile.
You combine a strong service mindset with analytical problem-solving, ownership and the ability to communicate technical topics clearly to business stakeholders
 What you’ll love about working here: 
Flexible and dynamic work environment involving teams spread across different global locations;
Communities with shared interests and identities, all working together to advance diversity, equity and inclusion within the workplace and society;
Do you want to learn more? You will have access to various training programs and platforms (e.g.: content provided by Pluralsight, Harvard and Coursera);
Attractive benefits package (meal tickets, medical services, Benefit online, Employee Share Option Plan, etc).
 Capgemini Romania is an equal opportunity employer. We promote equality and dignity in all aspects of recruitment and employment, and all offers of employment and promotions are made on the basis of performance, competence and ability.
 About Us: 
 Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 360,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fuelled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, Al, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group reported in 2022 global revenues of €22 billion.
